claim_in_screen: Clozapine reduced PDP vs placebo, SMD -1.31 (16 RCTs, n=1252); quetiapine inferior
effect_size: clozapine SMD -1.31 (95% CI -1.73 to -0.89) vs placebo; quetiapine vs clozapine SMD 0.47 (0.02 to 0.92); clozapine UPDRS-III MD -0.92 (-2.75 to 0.91)
flag: Mechanism proxy only: shows PDP responds to clozapine (broad receptor profile incl. muscarinic actions), not to M1/M4 agonism.

claim_in_screen: Low-dose clozapine beat placebo; quetiapine and olanzapine failed; olanzapine worsened EPS
flag: Overlaps the clozapine trials in 38412585 -> not independent of it. Useful motor point: olanzapine (D2) worsened EPS in PD.

claim_in_screen: IPD MA: ChEIs reduced delusions and hallucinations in PD subgroup, small effects
source_read: PMC record (abstract + key points; article body not in PMC open-access text) -> treat as abstract-level
effect_size: PD delusions -0.14 (95% CI -0.26 to -0.01; P=.04); PD hallucinations -0.08 (-0.13 to -0.03; P=.01); AD delusions -0.08, hallucinations -0.09
n: IPD 6649 total from 17 RCTs (12 AD, 5 PD); PD n not stated in abstract
flag: Effect sizes small. Cholinesterase inhibitors, not M1/M4 agonists.

claim_in_screen: IPD MA (5 PD RCTs): small SMDs; only PD delusions survived correction
effect_size: SMD -0.08 to -0.14 overall; -0.13 to -0.39 in symptomatic patients; after multiplicity correction only PD delusions significant
flag: Commentary on 37358841; re-analyses/critiques the same data, so it does not add an independent evidence item. Title calls the benefit "questionably significant".

claim_in_screen: PD with visual hallucinations shows reduced cholinergic FEOBV-PET uptake in left ventral visual stream
effect_size: cluster-level FWE P<0.05 (VH+ < VH-); no standardised effect size reported
flag: Small, cross-sectional. VH+ group had more advanced Hoehn&Yahr (VH+ median 2, range 2-4 vs VH- median 2, range 1-3; P=0.033; MDS-UPDRS-III 30.1 vs 25.6, P=0.211) -> possible confound. Patients on ChEIs/anticholinergics/clozapine excluded.

claim_in_screen: Xanomeline attenuated MK-801 hyperlocomotion and PPI deficits in mice, similar to pimavanserin
effect_size: hyperlocomotion attenuated at 1,3,10 mg/kg (p<0.01); PPI deficit attenuated at 10 mg/kg (p<0.05)
n: male C57BL/6J mice (n not in abstract)
flag: DOES NOT SUPPORT A PD-SPECIFIC CLAIM: NMDA-antagonist psychosis model in intact (non-parkinsonian) mice. Counts only as generic antipsychotic-like activity.

claim_in_screen: 83-year-old with treatment-resistant PDP: near-complete resolution on xanomeline-trospium 100/20 mg BID
effect_size: no rating scales; nighttime hallucinations resolved within 2 weeks at 50/20 BID; near-complete resolution by day 19 at 100/20 BID; sustained >6 months
flag: Single uncontrolled case; no NPI/SAPS/UPDRS scores. Same patient very likely reported to FAERS (case 27115291) -> FAERS is not independent of it.

effect_size: no effect of rivastigmine on time to PDP or dementia over 24 months; no motor difference at 6 months
flag: Contrary evidence missed by the screen (retrieval depth 6). Underpowered.
